name: Simple Support System
author: Fabian Bitter
description: Works the tickets of the self hosted Simple Support System helpdesk for Concrete CMS: read a ticket with its comments, reply, move it through its states, and manage projects, attachments and comment moderation.

SIMPLE_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of the Concrete CMS site running the Simple Support System package

SIMPLE_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_API_KEY.description: API key sent as the X-Api-Key header, needed for administrative calls

SIMPLE_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_PROJECT_TOKEN.description: Default access token for private projects
